# `•replace` — Replace regular expression matches

`text •replace [pattern template]` replaces each match of the regular expression `pattern` in `text` with `template`. Natively the template uses `$1` for a group, `${name}` for a named group, `$0` for the whole match and `$$` for `$`. In the browser it uses JavaScript's `$1`, `$<name>` and `$$`. Patterns follow [`•r`](r.qmd), and so does the keeping of compiled patterns.

```bpl
"ab12 cd3" •replace ["([a-z]+)([0-9]+)" "$2:$1"]   ⍝ "12:ab 3:cd"
•replace↢["[0-9]+" "#"] ¨"a1" "b22"                ⍝ "a#" "b#"
```

Errors: `DOMAIN` for invalid patterns, non-text arguments, and a right argument that isn't a pattern and a template; `SYNTAX` for the wrong valence; `LIMIT` for oversized results.
